notes: 六张图板均为AI生成参考，含设定视图、渲染风格图及昼夜小图，不是Blender实际模型渲染。
实体尺寸为美术提案，构图比例、生成文字和不同视图不能作为精确工程测量。
当前细节偏写实；后续建模可保留轮廓/材质层次并简化为CityX的风格化low poly。
04修正过前中景过于清楚的问题，最终使用浓雾修订版。05/06尽量保持相同街区与破损位置，但AI图之间仍有局部差异。
02背景个别普通路灯亮起属于生成偏差，不作为污染控制区运营规则；灯亮不能表示净化。06亦不能据局部灯光推导建筑自动运营。
净化区强调灰层退去而不是修复坍塌；所有图中的范围均非游戏权限判定。

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished production design board for CITYX, a modern-city reclamation strategy game, titled "01 / PURIFICATION TOWER". A restrained high-quality stylized 3D / low-poly PBR aesthetic: believable modern human engineering enclosing repurposed alien material; detailed bevels, subtle wear, coherent materials, not cartoon toy, not baroque futuristic magic.
One coherent tower design, never alternate unrelated variants. Layout: large three-quarter daytime physically-based hero render on right (about 60% board), clean smaller front elevation, true top-down plan and nighttime render on left. Warm off-white technical board, sparse neat English annotations and meters, no gameplay HUD.
Scale STRICT: construction site 40m x 40m, central equipment platform 20m square, whole structure 26m tall, alien core 4m wide near the upper center OPEN to view from above. Site has generous maintenance clearances, perimeter NOT a solid fortress wall. Include a 4.6m passenger car and 1.75m engineer silhouette on plan/elevation to establish scale. No giant oversized car.
Form: robust light concrete plinth, four articulated steel containment supports, cool gray painted processing cabinets, ceramic insulators, routed pipes/cables and service stairs. Center is a textured irregular layered alien mineral / organic crystal, anchored in visible human clamps, partially refined, not a floating jewel, not a perfectly smooth glowing sphere. Distinctive readable silhouette from high top-down camera. Pale cyan-white restrained core emission with retained surface detail. The tower is slightly advanced science, surrounded by plausible existing modern low-rise buildings.
Hero scene: normal asphalt and surviving ruined modern facades under soft natural daylight. Purification removes alien ash, NOT structural damage; keep some cracked pavement/rubble outside service pad. Delicate sparse cyan-white light strands spread outward and slightly upward from core, fade close to apparatus, not a giant shield dome, not concentric huge bright circles. Night inset: cool ambient fill, discernible structure, luminous core and gentle local light contrasting distant warm human windows. NO rotating searchlights, NO giant sky laser, NO attacks, NO resource/upgrade UI. Dimensions are visual proposals not confirmed gameplay mechanics.

Use case: stylized-concept. CITYX modern city reclamation game production design board titled "02 / MECHANICAL RELAY TOWER". Match a high-quality stylized 3D / low-poly PBR city game art direction, readable large forms with beveled realistic details, not an illustration of impossible hardware. This is FRIENDLY HUMAN unmanned network relay, absolutely NO purification core and NO manned watchtower. Warm off-white technical sheet. Layout: right 60% high-angle three-quarter daytime hero render, left front dimensioned elevation, true vertical top-down plan, small night hero render. SAME DESIGN in all views; restrained sparse English labels. No marketing slogans or HUD.
Size: 20m x20m site, a compact square concrete equipment base 5m x5m, total tower height18m, slim readable industrial mast with four legs/tapered structural truss, small low cabinets near base, maintenance clearance. Car4.6m and human1.75m solely size references. Hero has neighborhood buildings and road in correct scale; tower approximately six-storey height, taller than ordinary 3storey house. Keep equipment compact, do NOT fill entire site with huge building.
Top: modest antenna and sensor assembly, four FIXED broad downward/outward lamps at cardinal directions and ONE upward-facing lamp. Clear flat luminous upward-facing lamp surface visible directly overhead, halo/short soft vertical light path not an enormous beacon. No sweeping searchlights, no rotating spotlights, no weapon barrels, no operator cabin. Base power cabinet. Human gray steel/concrete, worn industrial yellow maintenance details, tiny cyan friendly status marker. Lamps neutral/cool white, distinct from warm residential street lamps.
Critical narrative: site and surrounding road still thickly coated in gray-beige volcanic-ash-like alien pollution. Ash collects at kerbs, pavement markings partly buried, airborne sparse dust, dirty cloud farther away. The relay provides control and vision, NOT purification. Ground remains lifeless and dusty under light. Do not magically clean a circle around tower, no happy lit houses, no grass-green purified area. Night inset: four static localized pools of coolwhite light illuminate dirty ash and near equipment, tower geometry remains visible in bluegray ambient light, upward lamp face visible with restrained halo. Physically plausible fixed light paths only. No all-map lighting, no radius rings.

Use case: stylized-concept. Design a production-ready concept and PBR rendered model sheet for CITYX titled "03 / LEGACY COMBAT MACHINE". Modern human-made abandoned autonomous war machine, NOT alien robot, no purification crystals. High quality stylized 3D low-poly game art, crisp readable shapes, bevels, physically believable steel/rubber, balanced weathering, no busy sci-fi greebles. Warm off-white technical board; sparse clear English labels.
Layout: right60% large three-quarter studio hero render on small ash-covered asphalt slab, left front, side and true top plan, bottom-left smaller night render in gray ash-covered modern city. SAME coherent vehicle in every view. Main prototype is compact TRACKED unmanned tankette, no humans aboard, no humanoid legs. Length4.6m, width2.5m, totalheight1.9m; restrained short cannon/autocannon mount, sensor block, compact engine vents, twin rubber/steel tracks, maintenance access, exposed human engineering and old serial/decal remnants. Include a small dimension comparison silhouette of a4.6m passengercar and1.75m person, only diagram scales, NOT an actual civilian target.
Readable low squat chassis with slightly offset sensor mast, powerful but car-sized NOT full-size battle tank or colossal mech. Old desaturated olivegray and gunmetal with wear and rusty seams; one small red-orange sensor/emitter, no full-red body, no friendly cyan or gold identification. Broad front recognizable at top-down city scale. Weapon articulation plausible but no firing at audience. Four-view consistency, no alternate giant design. Night inset: sparse red-orange optics and subtle warm internal machinery detail, bluegray ambient illumination keeps silhouette readable, low ash clouds beyond. Background contains no lit operational housing or civilian targets. No gore, no aliens, no faction battle, no radar circles, no magic glow, no spotlights. This is concept/render reference, no gameplay UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. CITYX environment art direction board titled "04 / UNKNOWN — POLLUTED". High-quality stylized 3D PBR strategy-city scene, hand-crafted clean volumes plus nuanced ash materials, soft daylight, believable modern city not fantasy. BOARD serves as a repeatable SAME LOCATION baseline for later controlled/purified states; do NOT make it an arbitrary apocalypse city of endless totally smashed buildings.
Layout: upper 65% wide high three-quarter city render, lower-left true top-down of exact same city, lower-right night version, very slim material-layer diagram strip with three English labels "ASH DEPOSITS / AIRBORNE DUST / HIGH DIRTY CLOUD". No HUD, no minimap, no radius grid, no captions pretending to be actual game.
Fixed scene geometry: neighborhood about160m square, central cross intersection with20m street width, two3storey palecream apartment blocks at left, redbrick3storey commercial block at rear right, small concrete parking/service square40m at center-left, tiny20m maintenance lot center-right. A few cracked roofs and partially collapsed corner, scattered abandoned car4.6m long, bare trees. Every building believable30–50m footprints, no giant cars. Site for future purification tower on left square currently empty, future mechanical relay on right lot currently empty. No player towers. Roads could carry car traffic but empty.
CRITICAL UNKNOWN state: most distant objects deeply obscured by thick SOFT warm-gray/dirtygray clouds, NOT clear whole map. Nearby very faint partial city silhouettes and short road fragments only. Dense clouds around distance at roof level and high above, with irregular layered patches and soft gradation; do not make uniform white blank canvas. Keep enough local foreground hints to read urban environment but NOT map all intersections. Heavy powdery volcanic-ash-like graybeige alien deposits on visible road/roofs, accumulated at kerbs and wall feet. Airborne fine dust. Three distinct layers: physical ash on surfaces, localized airborne dust, high gray dirty cloud ceiling. No actual volcanic lava or fire, no snow, no rain.
Night inset: bluegray fog with enough ambient illumination to read near silhouette, NO powered streetlights, NO lit habitation windows, no operational civilization lights. No aliens or POI markers exposed in fog, no tactical information, no red glows implying known enemies. Fog atmospheric, never flat black veil. Overall melancholy/unknown, not horror gore.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create board "05 / CONTROLLED — STILL POLLUTED" as an exact-location companion to image1. Image1 is the city GEOMETRY and layout reference. Image2 is the FRIENDLY MECHANICAL RELAY TOWER design reference, not an environment layout. Keep image1 buildings, road crossings, damage, cars, layout, cameras, upper wide render and lower topdown/night/material strips unchanged as far as possible. Use image2's slim18m industrial tower,5m square equipment base, upward luminous lamp face and four static outward/downward lamps; insert on20m maintenance lot at center-right of city, in all three views. NO purification tower or core.
This is MECHANICAL CONTROL + REALTIME VISION WITHOUT PURIFICATION. City near tower is visible clearly for play: move optical thick clouds out of line of sight through the nearby street intersection and ash-coated building surfaces; gentle gradation into dense unknown gray clouds at distance. Crucially DO NOT clean the ground or create green/healthy terrain. Roads and roofs thickly blanketed in gray-beige ash, marked drifts at kerbs, faded partly buried road markings, sparse fine airborne dust and dirty high cloud canopy. Buildings are desaturated and uninhabitable, with EXACT same damaged corner/roof. Camera sees terrain clearly below high cloud rather than cloud hiding entire battlefield. Tower locally illuminates ash, not purifies it. Main daylight render soft overcast sky, graybeige deposits clearly differ from cleaned black asphalt.
Night panel coolblue ambient fill with enough geometry visibility, FOUR FIXED WHITE localized light pools below mast and upper luminous lamp face, mild short soft vertical light trace, no moving spotlight cones, no gigantic beacon. All ordinary streetlights and habitation windows OFF, no warm civilization lights, no people, no green lawns. Topdown should make tower base vs20m lot scale believable, ground gray and detailed, ONLY dense cloud beyond observed neighborhood. Material strip labels "ASH REMAINS / DUST REMAINS / VISION RESTORED". Use same restrained stylized3D PBR game-quality materials, no gameplay HUD or overlay radius circles. Difference comes from revealed polluted surfaces, not gray screen tint.

Use case: stylized-concept. Produce CITYX exact-location third-state board titled "06 / PURIFIED — HABITABLE". Image1 is the city geometry / composition reference (controlled polluted neighborhood with relay); image2 is PURIFICATION TOWER design reference. Preserve image1 city grid, three-storey pale cream apartments atleft, redbrick blockbackright, cars, SAME DAMAGED CORNERS, bare trees, streets, cameras, wide main hero, lowerleft true topdown / lower middle night / right material strip. Preserve friendly18m mechanical relay at small rightlot. Insert one purification tower matching image2 on empty40m-square LEFT PARKING/SERVICE LOT, platform20m, height26m, core4m wide, four steel containment supports enclosing alien material and routed cabinets. Correct scale against4.6m vehicles and3storey houses; tower not gigantic skyscraper. Same purifier in allviews.
CRITICAL environmental transformation: nearby region is now breathable due to purification. REMOVE physical gray volcanic-ash coating from asphalt, roofs and facades. Reveal rich but restrained original blackgray asphalt, white/yellow street markings, beige plaster, reddish brick, muted blue window glass. Fine dust/haze cleared inside neighborhood, soft natural daylight and clean air. Distant city remains under visibly thick gray/cloudbanks with gentle transition. Do NOT fill in any collapsed wall or roof, do NOT remove rubble piles or normal age/grime, do NOT grow leaves on dead trees or turn broken cars into newcars. This demonstrates purification NOT instant reconstruction. Aesthetic hopeful and calm but existing broken urban fabric recognizable; no overbright saturated toycity.
Core soft pale cyan-white, textured irregular repurposed alien material anchored with human clamps, faint sparse light threads outward/slightlyupward near apparatus. No forcefield bubble or enormous radiuswave, no magic greenpaint on floor. Thin cyan silhouette detailing only on friendly equipment.
Night inset: readable cool ambient city and gentle tower cyan-white worklight, local relay fixed neutral white lamps. Most buildings still abandoned/unrepaired and UNLIT, no automatic all-window warm lighting due only to purification. To show distinction, material strip labels "ASH CLEARED / CLEAN AIR / DAMAGE REMAINS" with clean asphalt closeup, cleared air distantcloud boundary, SAME original broken roof closeup. No inhabitants, no newly planted park, no tacticalcircles/UI. Highquality stylized3D lowpoly/PBR, physically plausible bevels/materials. Main foreground air pristine even though far highclouds remain.

corrections.prompt: Edit this CITYX environment board. Preserve exact board layout, city geometry, camera and materials, but CORRECT THE UNKNOWN FOG STATE. The image currently exposes almost every nearby street/building; this violates the design. Add thick dimensional dirty warm-gray cloud banks through the FOREGROUND AND MIDDLE GROUND as well as distance in ALL THREE city panels. Around75–85% of city area must be concealed under opaque or nearly opaque cloud. Only discontinuous short road fragments and faint silhouettes in small cloud gaps, no entire readable street network or building inventories. Topdown inset MUST also have dense clouds covering most roofs/roads, not a clear aerial map. Layer billowing off-white/graybeige polluted clouds, soft variable edges, shade variation; not uniform flat white mask, no black. Keep small ash-coated foreground hints and existing three material closeups. Night scene same occlusion, deep grayblue cloud texture and a few silhouettes, no lights. Do not change viewpoint, do not add towers/enemies/UI. Title "04 / UNKNOWN — POLLUTED" unchanged. This is truly unexplored unknown city hidden by fog, not an already surveyed neighborhood with distant haze.
